name: Mattenai
overview: The name Mattenai appears in the post-exilic period, associated with individuals who exemplify faithfulness to God's covenant community. In Ezra 10:33 and 10:37, Mattenai is listed among Israelites who put away their Gentile wives, demonstrating a commitment to holiness after the captivity. Additionally, Nehemiah 12:19 identifies a priest named Mattenai in the time of Joiakim, indicating the name's presence among religious leaders dedicated to the temple worship. These references collectively highlight Mattenai as a figure connected to the restoration and purity of Israel during the return from exile.
